timeline.title: Poland Invaded
timeline.description: Germany invades Poland, marking the beginning of World War II. Polish forces mobilize to defend their homeland.

timeline.title: Escape to England
timeline.description: Following the fall of Poland, Stanislaw escapes to England to continue the fight with the RAF.

timeline.title: Active Service
timeline.description: Active combat missions over Europe, defending Britain and supporting Allied operations.
